decision: Add a clean-worktree, exact-SHA local mission-runtime qualification gate while keeping independent hosted CI as the release authority.
winner: local exact-SHA qualification + hosted CI remains mandatory

reviews.correctness: Runs the same mission-runtime suite before benchmarking the real coordinator failure path; refuses dirty or wrong-SHA evidence.
reviews.robustness_security: Fail-closed on test failure, SHA mismatch, dirty worktree, missing benchmark measurements or budget failure. It does not weaken persistence, fencing, idempotency or fail-closed coordinator controls.
reviews.latency_resources_regression: Runs sequentially and locally, adds no worker/Qubes traffic and no production runtime overhead. Smaller regression surface than changing rollback semantics while CI is unavailable.

alternatives_rejected.reason: Produces no new engineering evidence and leaves agents idle.

alternatives_rejected.approach: Treat local qualification as release CI
alternatives_rejected.reason: Not independent; unacceptable as the final release authority.
Increases state-equivalence and regression complexity without measured evidence that exact rollback exceeds budgets.

alternatives_rejected.approach: Start Qubes transport slice before Slice 1 evidence
alternatives_rejected.reason: Builds distributed reliability on an unqualified dependency root.

lesson: A local evidence path can keep reliability work moving during hosted-runner outages, but it must remain explicitly subordinate to independent CI and real Qubes qualification.
